faq.q: When can you come out to inspect my roof?
faq.a: We're open Mon–Sun 7 AM–9 PM. Call or use this form to schedule a free inspection. Emergency repairs available 24/7.

faq.q: Do you help with insurance claims?
faq.a: Yes, we provide free storm damage inspections and assist with filing insurance claims. Call us to schedule.

faq.q: What's your warranty on roof repairs and new roofs?
faq.a: We offer a 2-year workmanship warranty on all labor. Call us to discuss specific coverage for your project.

faq.q: How quickly can you respond to emergency damage?
faq.a: We're available 24/7 for emergency tarp service and urgent repairs. Call (704) 307-9171 anytime.
